#175 · Spike Ball Pokémon

Togepi

Fairy

Johto · Generation 2 · Baby Pokémon

Togepi is a Fairy-type Spike Ball Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 1.5 kg. It evolves into Togetic. Its highest base stat is Defense (65), with a base stat total of 245.
